question_summary: Contractor requests approval to substitute ABS DWV piping for the specified no-hub cast-iron soil piping under Section 22 13 16 prior to fixture rough-in.
referenced_documents: ABS DWV cut sheet and third-party listing
proposed_solution: Use ABS DWV alternate piping in lieu of specified no-hub cast-iron soil piping, supported by cut sheet and listing.
deadline_text: A response by the end of the day
routing_rationale: The request concerns a DWV piping material substitution under Plumbing spec Section 22 13 16, requiring plumbing engineering review of compliance with performance requirements.
